_comment: Example AgentCore Runtime deployment inputs. Every value is a visibly
synthetic placeholder: the account is all zeroes, the image digest is a
repeated byte, and none of these resources exists. Copy this file, replace
the placeholders with your own identifiers, and keep it out of version
control. It holds resource identifiers and pinned non-secret versions
only; the contract refuses a value shaped like a credential.
network_mode has no default. VPC names its own subnets and security
groups. PUBLIC additionally needs owner_approved_public_egress, because
the installed service contract documents no semantics for it.
telemetry is optional. runtime_arn, runtime_id, agent_id and model_id are
deploy outputs rather than inputs, so they are absent here and the live
telemetry gate stays pending until a deployment has been observed.
